reviewed_new_code.method: measured_requirement = max(0, G_move - (S * (1 + ratio) + slack)), measured by tools/architecture/net_move.py at recorded_at_revision with base origin/3.4.3 (merge-base 793851676, the #1266 integration): S = 113, G_move = 77, ratio and slack credits = 113 * 1.05 + 300 = 418.65, so the requirement is -341.65 and the reviewed budget above is 0. Growth outside the destination roots (tooling, documentation, test trees, other crates) is reported as accounted growth and is not charged.

#1266 integrated the F4b/F5 checkpoint into 3.4.3, so the merge-base moved from 24a513855 to 793851676 and the 37363-line reviewed budget measured against the old base no longer applies. The budget restarts from the measured requirement against the new base; the phases above are the history of the previous base.

The condition projection constructor moves from the World session to the application crate, built on the core hub's own condition access instead of a second copy of its fixture-reference list, together with the application evaluation of one PlayerCondition id. The World methods become wrappers; the application group context, resolved group seam and quest-query context receive the host's World-test flag instead of computing their own cfg, and the group test shims build their context through one helper.
